Перейдите в каталог `~/vol-dumpxml-xpath`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-volumes-vol-dumpxml-xpath}
#### XML и XPath volume
Сохраните полный XML и XPath-значения:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-dumpxml --pool lab-pool lab-disk.qcow2 > lab-disk.xml
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-dumpxml --pool lab-pool --xpath 'string(/volume/name)' lab-disk.qcow2 > xpath-name.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-dumpxml --pool lab-pool --xpath 'string(/volume/capacity)' lab-disk.qcow2 > xpath-capacity.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-dumpxml --pool lab-pool --xpath 'string(/volume/target/format/@type)' lab-disk.qcow2 > xpath-format.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-dumpxml --pool lab-pool --xpath 'string(/volume/target/path)' lab-disk.qcow2 > xpath-path.txt
```
:::
